notes: DON'T: 15 plan items in one state, one score question per items[i]. 2.8x fewer tokens than 15 single calls, but precise items scored up to 2.03 levels too vague. Batch questions about one item, not items per request.

items: Add a `--json` flag to `planroom scan` in crates/planroom-cli; done when the scan_json snapshot test passes.
Set SQLite journal_mode=WAL in planroom-store's Store::open; done when `cargo test -p planroom-store wal_mode` passes.
Raise DecisionCard button height to 48px in web/canvas/src/DecisionCard.tsx; done when the 390x844 Playwright tap-target check passes.
Return JevError::RateLimited on HTTP 429 in crates/planroom-decide/src/jev.rs; done when the jev_429 contract test passes.
Remove legacy_layout.rs from planroom-server; done when clippy passes with -D warnings.
Add a decision cache to planroom-store keyed by state hash.
Speed up the canvas so it loads in under a second.
Write docs for the CLI; done when a new user can follow them.
